  "concordance_definition": "The study aimed to analyze IRAK3 expression, and its effects and correlation to inflammatory cytokine expression (TNF-α and IL-6), using meta-analyses of quantitative data from previous studies of in vivo animal or human models after one- or two-challenge interventions which mimic sepsis conditions.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "High heterogeneity across studies, especially in meta-analyses of IL-6 and TNF-α protein levels following one-challenge.",
    "High heterogeneity between animal studies may be explained by different models to induce illness or injury and varying regimens of stimulant dosing.",
    "Problems of internal validity of animal studies, including poor study design, conduct, analysis or reporting.",
    "Lack of blinding of treatments in animal studies.",
    "Most studies did not mention whether random allocation or blinded intervention and assessment were performed.",
    "Several meta-analyses include only two studies due to shortage of studies using similar methods.",
    "In vitro models of disease-related cell types or tissues should be performed to confirm IRAK3 functions in immune responses from animal studies.",
    "Species differences in underlying biology between humans and animals lead to failures in assessing efficacy and safety of interventions at human clinical trials.",
    "Mouse models show low correlation of gene expression changes in endotoxemia to human orthologs, and poorly mimic the genomic responses in patients with sepsis and infections.",
    "Basic dissimilarities in immune responses between human and murine species exist."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "49 million incident cases of sepsis worldwide in 2017.",
    "11 million sepsis-related deaths in 2017.",
    "19.7% of all global deaths were sepsis-related in 2017.",
    "16302 studies identified through database searches.",
    "8549 duplicate studies removed.",
    "25 additional studies identified through citation tracking.",
    "149 studies selected after title/abstract screening.",
    "49 studies included in the systematic review.",
    "12 studies reported data from human in vivo models.",
    "34 studies used rodents (mice or rats).",
    "3 studies used sheep, cows, or pigs.",
    "Human studies used LPS administration with in vivo doses of 2–4 ng/kg.",
    "Animal studies used LPS administration with in vivo doses of 0.1–45 mg/kg or 2–400 μg/mouse.",
    "20 studies used two-challenge intervention.",
    "9 studies used IRAK3 gene knockout or silencing.",
    "44 studies measured outcomes between 1h and 72h following the first challenge.",
    "Human in vivo studies show significant increase of TNF-α protein level at ST (P < 0.00001, I² = 75%).",
    "Human in vivo studies show increased IL-6 level at ST (P < 0.00001, I² = 47%) and IT (P < 0.0001, I² = 0%).",
    "Rodent meta-analyses of TNF-α: ST (P = 0.002, I² = 87%), IT (P = 0.003, I² = 93%), LT (P < 0.00001, I² = 93%).",
    "Rodent meta-analyses of IL-6: ST (P < 0.00001, I² = 41%), IT (P < 0.0001, I² = 72%), LT (P < 0.00001, I² = 91%).",
    "Meta-analysis of IRAK3 effect on TNF-α mRNA expression in mice at LT (P = 0.03, I² = 0%).",
    "Meta-analyses suggest no effect of IRAK3 on TNF-α protein expression at ST (P = 0.42, I² = 0%) or LT (P = 0.49, I² = 70%).",
    "Meta-analyses suggest no effect of IRAK3 on IL-6 protein expression at ST (P = 0.33, I² = 0%) or LT (P = 0.74, I² = 84%).",
    "Meta-analyses of rodent in vivo studies show significant increases of IRAK3 mRNA (P = 0.006, I² = 62%) and protein (P < 0.00001, I² = 0%) following two challenges.",
    "Meta-analyses show TNF-α and IL-6 protein levels significantly decreased in humans following two-challenges (TNF-α: P < 0.0001, I² = 0%; IL-6: P < 0.0001, I² = 45%).",
    "Meta-analysis of mice in vivo studies demonstrates significant decrease of TNF-α protein levels after two-challenges (P = 0.02, I² = 78%).",
    "Meta-analyses of two-challenge intervention identified an inhibitory effect of IRAK3 on TNF-α mRNA (P = 0.007, I² = 0%) and protein (P = 0.0007, I² = 0%) expression in mice."
  ]
